item: table_plan() on a hand-built long frame of zero rows stops with R's own error, not a message of the package's
risk_basis: the user sees an unhelpful message; no wrong table is written, the run stops
reason: it stops before any output, so no wrong RTF can be produced; the normal route (a cards ARD) stops with the package's message (FR-PL124)
action: add the guard and its test (an issue before the first release)

item: plan_digits(<column> = n) on a plan with plan_cells(stats = "rows") is documented to format that column, but today it does nothing and a key that reaches nothing is not refused either
risk_basis: the numbers print unformatted (every decimal the data carries), which a reviewer sees at once; no wrong number is written
reason: the documented route for a table of statistics as rows is plan_digits(.rows = ), which works and is tested (FR-PL244); a column key is the finished-table form
action: an issue before the first release: format the column (or refuse the key) and add the test
